title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: Research revision of the four-dimensional sphere packing manuscript. A uniform annular estimate preserves at least 77% of the volume left by the inner shell. The cap certificates and the annular correction give density below 0.634764. The unrestricted 24-neighbour case and the residual 25–27-neighbour cases remain open.
